title: fleet chart values
description: Typo guard. Helm silently renders nothing for a key the templates do not read, so a misspelled value passes helm lint, passes helm template, and surfaces only as behaviour missing in production — sandbox.kubernetes.bundleDocsInImage being the sharpest case, where the symptom is view_file refusals on a running cluster. Objects whose keys are a fixed, known set are closed with additionalProperties:false; free-form maps (env, labels, annotations, selectors) stay open.

env.description: Extra environment for the control plane, rendered verbatim (quote every value). Properties are generated from the configuration registry (docs/CONFIGURATION.md, `make config-docs`); other keys — the client bundle's connector variables — are accepted too. Put secrets in config.existingSecret instead.

ADMIN_API_KEY.description: Admin API key for the orchestrator's admin endpoints (and `fleet mcp reload`). Not reloadable. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated emails that are chat admins.

APP_SESSION_SECRET.description: HMAC key that signs the browser session cookie. Required for sign-in. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

AUTH_COOKIE_DOMAIN.description: Shared cookie domain (e.g. elcanotek.com), needed for cross-subdomain sign-out.

AUTH_COOKIE_NAME.description: Name of the Elcano auth cookie. Default: elcano_auth.

AUTH_LOGIN_URL.description: Base URL of the Elcano auth service the sign-in page sends people to.

AUTH_SIGNING_PREVIOUS_PUBKEYS.description: Comma-separated previous Ed25519 public keys still accepted during a key rotation.

AUTH_SIGNING_PUBKEY.description: Ed25519 public key (standard base64) that verifies the Elcano `elcano_auth` cookie. Set it with `fleet config set-auth-pubkey`.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS credentials for the email MCP server (and the Bedrock provider through the AWS SDK). Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

AWS_REGION.description: AWS region for the email MCP server and the Bedrock provider.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: AWS secret for the email MCP server (and the Bedrock provider through the AWS SDK). Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

BROWSERBASE_API_KEY.description: Browserbase key that mints live-view links (docs/BROWSERBASE.md). Set it with `fleet config set-browserbase-key`. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

CATWALK_URL.description: URL of the Catwalk app linked from the browser tier.

DATABASE_URL.description: The Postgres DSN: ONE database, the chat store in schema chat and the scheduler store in schema sched (ADR-0098). Unset, it is built from the DB_* parts. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env. The chart sets it from postgres.enabled (in-cluster database secret; set that value instead.

DB_HOST.description: Postgres host, used to build a DSN when no URL is set. Default: localhost.

DB_NAME.description: Postgres database name for the discrete DSN parts. Default: fleet.

DB_PASSWORD.description: Postgres password for the discrete DSN parts. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

DB_PORT.description: Postgres port for the discrete DSN parts. Default: 5432.

DB_SSLMODE.description: Postgres sslmode for the discrete DSN parts. Default: disable.

DB_USER.description: Postgres user for the discrete DSN parts. Default: fleet.

DEBUG.description: A cutlass-era knob: fleet reads nothing from it, but it stays admitted from the env file and reserved from connectors.

EMAIL_ATTACHMENT_DIR.description: Directory for uploads and email attachments. A relative value is resolved against the working directory (not FLEET_DATA_DIR) to an absolute path at load. The chart sets it from dataDir (+ /attachments; set that value instead. Default: ./data/attachments.

EMAIL_LAST_CHECK_FILE.description: Email MCP: state file of the last mailbox check.

EMAIL_S3_BUCKET.description: Email MCP: S3 bucket of inbound mail.

EMAIL_S3_DATE_PREFIX_FORMAT.description: Email MCP: date layout of the S3 prefix.

EMAIL_S3_MAX_DATE_PREFIX_DAYS.description: Email MCP: how many days of date prefixes to scan.

EMAIL_S3_PREFIX.description: Email MCP: S3 key prefix of inbound mail.

FLEET_A2A_CLIENT_ALLOW_PRIVATE.description: Allow outbound A2A calls to private addresses. Default: false.

FLEET_A2A_ENABLED.description: The inbound A2A protocol server (routes answer 501 until enabled). Default: false.

FLEET_A2A_MAX_DELEGATION_DEPTH.description: Ceiling on A2A delegation depth, inbound and outbound. Default: 3.

FLEET_A2A_MODEL.description: Model inbound A2A tasks run on.

FLEET_A2A_PERSONA.description: Persona inbound A2A tasks run as.

FLEET_A2A_PUSH_ALLOW_PRIVATE.description: Allow A2A push notifications to private addresses. Default: false.

FLEET_A2A_UNARY_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long a blocking A2A message/send waits for the task. Default: 1800.

FLEET_ACCOUNT_EVENTS_SECRET.description: Retired with the account-events feed (ADR-0096): boot warns when it is set. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

FLEET_ACCOUNT_EVENTS_URL.description: Retired with the account-events feed (ADR-0096): boot warns when it is set.

FLEET_ADVANCED_MODEL.description: Env default of the advanced model tier (admin setting advanced_model).

FLEET_ALLOWED_DIRS.description: Extra colon-separated directories the host-side file tools may touch, beyond the workspace.

FLEET_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: How long an approval card waits. Also an admin setting. Default: 86400.

FLEET_AUDIT_DIR.description: Directory of the bash tool's audit log. Default: inherited from FLEET_DATA_DIR.

FLEET_AUTO_APPROVE_IN_TEST.description: Test harness only: auto-approve approval cards. Default: false.

FLEET_AUTO_ARCHIVE_AFTER_DAYS.description: Auto-archive a conversation this many days after its last activity; 0 leaves archiving to the user. Default: 0.

FLEET_AUTO_TITLE.description: Title conversations automatically. Also an admin setting. Default: true.

FLEET_BUDGET_WINDDOWN_FRACTION.description: Budget fraction at which the agent is told to wind down; clamped to (0,1]. Default: 0.8.

FLEET_CHAT_DATABASE_URL.description: Deprecated (ADR-0098): the chat store's own database on a box not yet consolidated (`fleet db consolidate`); set, it selects the legacy two-database layout. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env. The chart sets it from postgres.enabled (in-cluster database secret; set that value instead.

FLEET_CHAT_DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT.description: Chat pool: timeout of the initial ping at startup. Default: 5s.

FLEET_CHAT_DB_MAX_CONNS.description: Chat pool: maximum open connections. Default: 25.

FLEET_CHAT_DB_MAX_CONN_IDLE_TIME.description: Chat pool: close a connection idle this long; 0 never does. Default: 0.

FLEET_CHAT_DB_MAX_CONN_LIFETIME.description: Chat pool: maximum connection lifetime; 0 is unlimited. Default: 5m.

FLEET_CHAT_DB_MIN_CONNS.description: Chat pool: maximum idle connections kept. Default: 5.

FLEET_CHAT_RATE_LIMIT_CONCURRENT.description: Concurrent chat turns per user. Default: 5.

FLEET_CLEANUP_HOUR.description: Hour of day (server time) of the retention cleanup. Default: 4.

FLEET_CLIENT_CONFIG_DIR.description: Client-config bundle directory (branding, MCP catalog, personas, sandbox Containerfile). Set by the systemd unit; not read from the env file. Default: the built-in config/default bundle.

FLEET_CONNECTOR_RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED.description: Connector auto-recommendation. Also an admin setting. Default: false.

FLEET_CONTEXT_COMPACTION_THRESHOLD.description: Context-window fraction at which the transcript is compacted; clamped to (0,1]. Default: 0.90.

FLEET_CONTEXT_ELIDE_BEFORE_SUMMARY.description: Scheduled compaction elides stale tool results before summarising. Default: true.

FLEET_CONTEXT_HANDLES_ENABLED.description: Composer context handles. Also an admin setting. Default: false.

FLEET_CONTEXT_PRESSURE_WARN_THRESHOLD.description: Context-window fraction at which the agent is warned; clamped to (0,1]. Default: 0.75.

FLEET_CONTEXT_RESEND_BUDGET_TOKENS.description: Scheduled runs: resent-prompt budget per call before compaction; 0 disables. Default: 80000.

FLEET_CONVERSATION_SOFT_DELETE.description: Deleting a conversation hides it instead of removing it. Default: false.

FLEET_DATA_DIR.description: Data directory: journals, caches, uploads, the encrypted key store. The chart sets it from dataDir; set that value instead. Default: ./data.

FLEET_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Env default of the workspace's everyday model tier (admin setting default_model).

FLEET_DEFAULT_NETWORK_MODE.description: Default sandbox egress mode. An unknown value refuses to boot. Default: open.

FLEET_DEFAULT_THINKING_BUDGET_TOKENS.description: Default reasoning budget in tokens; 0 leaves it to the model. Default: 0.

FLEET_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone given to a task created without one. Default: UTC.

FLEET_DISABLE_OPENROUTER_MODELS.description: Never fetch the live OpenRouter model catalog. Default: false.

FLEET_DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHE.description: Disable explicit prompt-cache breakpoints. Default: false.

FLEET_DISK_MIN_FREE_PERCENT.description: Below this free-space percentage, scheduled work is shed. Default: 5.

FLEET_DRAIN_FILE.description: Older name of FLEET_UPDATE_DRAIN_FILE, read when that is unset. Default: inherited from FLEET_ENV_FILE.

FLEET_ENVIRONMENT.description: Deployment tier tag on Sentry events (production, staging, dev). Default: dev.

FLEET_ENV_FILE.description: The deployment env file. `fleet serve` loads it when set (the systemd unit passes the file through EnvironmentFile= instead); operator CLI verbs resolve it with --env-file first. A value inside the file itself could never take effect. Default: /etc/fleet/fleet.env on a provisioned box, else .env.local for CLI verbs.

FLEET_ERROR_ANALYSIS_ENABLED.description: Analyse failed runs with FLEET_ERROR_ANALYSIS_MODEL. Also an admin setting. Default: true.

FLEET_ERROR_ANALYSIS_MODEL.description: Model that analyses failed runs. Default: inherited from FLEET_METADATA_MODEL.

FLEET_ESCALATION_CLASSIFIER_MODE.description: Chat escalation classifier mode (docs/CHAT-ESCALATION.md). A mistyped value refuses to boot. Default: suggest.

FLEET_ESCALATION_CLASSIFIER_MODEL.description: Model the escalation classifier calls. Default: ~typesafe/jev-latest.

FLEET_ESCALATION_CLASSIFIER_THRESHOLD.description: Classifier confidence, in percent, above which a card is staged. Default: 80.

FLEET_IMAGE_MODEL.description: Default model of the generate_image tool.

FLEET_INPUT_QUEUE_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Days finished input-queue rows keep their idempotency keys; 0 disables the purge. Default: 30.

FLEET_IP_ALLOWLIST.description: Comma-separated IPs/CIDRs allowed to reach fleet; empty allows every source. A malformed entry refuses to boot.

FLEET_IP_DENYLIST.description: Comma-separated IPs/CIDRs always blocked (deny overrides allow).

FLEET_KEEP_RUNS_PER_TASK.description: Superseded run logs kept per scheduled task before the retention sweep prunes the oldest. Default: 10.

FLEET_LIBRARY_PROMPT_MODEL.description: Model that drafts prompt-library entries. Default: inherited from FLEET_METADATA_MODEL.

FLEET_LOCKDOWN_ALLOWED_MODELS.description: Comma-separated model slugs (or `*` globs) a lockdown conversation may run on; the first literal entry is the lockdown default. Unset, the list is the workspace's current default and advanced models, so lockdown follows a tier change live. A lockdown conversation whose model is no longer listed moves to the lockdown default on its next turn; a list of globs only has no literal to move to, so give it a literal first entry. Default: the two model tiers.

FLEET_LOCKDOWN_ONLY.description: Only lockdown (no-egress) conversations; needs a sandbox image. A mistyped value refuses to boot. Default: false.

FLEET_LOG_ARCHIVE_AFTER_DAYS.description: Archive run logs older than this; 0 disables. Default: 0.

FLEET_LOG_ARCHIVE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Base64 AES-256 key encrypting log archives; unset or malformed archives gzip-only. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

FLEET_LOG_FILE.description: Opt-in rotating process log file; empty logs to stderr only. Agent session logs are written beside it.

FLEET_LOG_LEVEL.description: Minimum level of the json log format. Default: info.

FLEET_LOG_MAX_AGE_DAYS.description: Delete rotated files older than this; 0 keeps them. Default: 0.

FLEET_LOG_MAX_SIZE_MB.description: Rotate the log file at this size. Default: 100.

FLEET_MAINTENANCE_MIN_INTERVAL.description: Minimum spacing between two maintenance passes started over HTTP. Default: 5m.

FLEET_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS.description: Box-wide cap on concurrently running agents (chat turns and scheduled runs). Sizes the admission semaphore and the warm pool at startup. Default: 8.

FLEET_MAX_COST_USD.description: Cost ceiling per run, in USD. Hot-reloadable; an admin override wins. Default: 50.

FLEET_MAX_ITERATIONS.description: Maximum agent loop iterations per run. Hot-reloadable. Default: 300.

FLEET_MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT_BYTES.description: Cap on one tool result handed to the model, in bytes (clamped to the built-in bounds). Default: 65536.

FLEET_MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS.description: Token ceiling per run. Hot-reloadable; an admin override wins. Default: 10000000.

FLEET_MCP_OAUTH_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Base64 AES-256 key sealing per-user remote-MCP OAuth tokens. Unset or malformed keeps remote MCP OAuth off. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

FLEET_MCP_OUTBOUND_ATTACHMENT_DIR.description: Internal: exported when the configuration loads (fleet serve and the MCP broker it starts, fleet task run, fleet mcp test) as the absolute EMAIL_ATTACHMENT_DIR/outbound; MCP spawns append it to connector *ALLOWED_DIRS lists that admit the workspace root (docs/MCP-BUNDLE-ENV.md). Not operator-facing: loading overwrites any value.

FLEET_MEMORY_AUTOINDEX_ENABLED.description: Index conversations into memory automatically. Also an admin setting. Default: false.

FLEET_MEMORY_GRAPH_ENABLED.description: Build the memory graph. Default: false.

FLEET_MEMORY_GRAPH_MODEL.description: Model for the memory graph. Default: inherited from FLEET_MEMORY_MODEL.

FLEET_MEMORY_MODEL.description: Model for memory indexing. Default: inherited from FLEET_METADATA_MODEL.

FLEET_METADATA_MODEL.description: Model for auxiliary metadata jobs. Default: inherited from FLEET_TITLE_MODEL.

FLEET_MOCK_MODE.description: Test harness: run without a real model (requires a build with the host-executor tag). Default: false.

FLEET_MODEL_CACHE_TTL_MINUTES.description: Minutes the live OpenRouter model catalog is cached. Default: 60.

FLEET_NOTIFY_ON.description: Task statuses that notify (comma-separated; failure includes blocked); empty notifies on every status. Nothing is sent until a channel (SMTP or webhook) is configured (docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md).

FLEET_NOTIFY_RETRIES.description: Retries of a failed notification delivery. Default: 2.

FLEET_NOTIFY_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout of one notification delivery. Default: 10s.

FLEET_OIDC_ALLOWED_DOMAINS.description: Comma-separated email domains allowed to sign in through OIDC; empty allows any.

FLEET_OIDC_ALLOW_PASSWORD.description: Break-glass: keep Fleet passwords working while central Auth SSO is configured. Default: false.

FLEET_OIDC_AUTO_START.description: An anonymous /login first tries SSO silently (prompt=none). Default: false.

FLEET_OIDC_BUTTON_LABEL.description: Label of the SSO button on the sign-in page.

FLEET_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OIDC client secret. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

FLEET_OIDC_GENERIC.description: Marks the OIDC provider as a generic identity provider (Okta, Entra, …) rather than central Auth, so Fleet keeps its own passwords and account management. Default: false.

FLEET_OIDC_ISSUER.description: OIDC issuer URL. With the client ID and secret it turns on SSO; with central Auth it also turns Fleet passwords off (ADR-0095).

FLEET_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI.description: OIDC redirect URI, when it must differ from the one derived from the public origin. Default: inherited from FLEET_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.

FLEET_OIDC_SCOPES.description: Space-separated OIDC scopes requested at sign-in. Default: openid email.

FLEET_OPENROUTER_BASE_URL.description: Prefixed spelling of OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, read when that is unset.

FLEET_ORCHESTRATOR_ADDR.description: Listen address of the orchestrator (scheduler HTTP API, /v1, triggers). Loopback by default; multi-host topologies opt in explicitly. The chart sets it from fixed: 0.0.0.0:8000; set that value instead. Default: 127.0.0.1:8000.

FLEET_ORCHESTRATOR_BOOTSTRAP_ADMINS.description: Comma-separated emails provisioned (or promoted) as orchestrator admins at every boot. Ignored when central Auth manages accounts.

FLEET_OTEL_ENDPOINT.description: OTLP/gRPC endpoint for traces; unset leaves tracing off.

FLEET_OTEL_SAMPLE_RATIO.description: Trace head-sampling ratio. Lenient: a bad value samples everything and validate-config reports it. Default: 1.

FLEET_OWNER_ID.description: The owning release, so the orphan sweep never touches a co-tenant release's pods. The chart sets it from downward API: release instance label; set that value instead.

FLEET_PAUSED_TASK_EXPIRY_MINUTES.description: Expire a paused task after this long; 0 waits forever. Default: 0.

FLEET_PERSONA.description: Persona FILE the drivers load (by basename, from the bundle's personas/); .yaml is appended when no known extension is given. Default: personas/assistant.yaml.

FLEET_PERSONA_DEFAULT.description: Default persona name for new conversations. Default: assistant.

FLEET_PHONE_A_FRIEND_ENABLED.description: Super-LLM review (phone a friend). Also an admin setting. Default: false.

FLEET_PII_RAMPART_URL.description: Retired with the Rampart engine (ADR-0063): nothing reads it; boot warns when it is set.

FLEET_PII_REDACTION_ENABLED.description: PII redaction with the built-in pattern engine. Default: false.

FLEET_PII_REDACTION_ENGINE.description: Retired with the Rampart engine (ADR-0063): nothing reads it; boot warns when it is set.

FLEET_PINNED_MODELS.description: JSON array of `{"slug","label","tag","free","input_price_per_mtok","output_price_per_mtok"}` pins: models both pickers list right after the recommended rows, with an optional display label, tag pill and displayed price. Display only — the real slug is sent and recorded and spend is metered at the provider's price. A malformed value refuses to boot (docs/PINNED-MODELS.md).

FLEET_POD_UID.description: The control-plane pod's UID, used to tell its own sandbox pods from a predecessor's. The chart sets it from downward API: metadata.uid; set that value instead.

FLEET_PROVIDER_FIRST_CHUNK_TIMEOUT_MAX_S.description: Cap on the prompt-scaled first-chunk deadline. Default: 180.

FLEET_PROVIDER_FIRST_CHUNK_TIMEOUT_SECON.description: Base deadline for a provider's first streamed event (floor 5 s, scaled with the prompt). Default: 75.

FLEET_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Public origin of this deployment (https://fleet.example.com). Used for OAuth redirect URIs, links and the browser tier's origin checks; a trailing slash is trimmed.

FLEET_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL used to build deep links in task notifications and Web Push messages.

FLEET_PUSH_ON_APPROVAL_REQUEST.description: Push when an approval is requested. Default: true.

FLEET_PUSH_ON_TASK_COMPLETE.description: Push when a task finishes. Default: true.

FLEET_PYTHON_CELL_TIMEOUT.description: Per-cell timeout in seconds; 0 uses the tool default. Default: 0.

FLEET_PYTHON_REPL_IDLE_TTL.description: Seconds an idle persistent REPL lives. Default: 21600.

FLEET_PYTHON_REPL_MODE.description: Python REPL lifetime: a fresh interpreter per turn, or one per conversation. Default: per-turn.

FLEET_RECURRING_TASK_MODEL.description: Model that drafts recurring tasks. Default: inherited from FLEET_METADATA_MODEL.

FLEET_REMOTE_MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP.description: Allow remote MCP servers over plain http (development only). Default: false.

FLEET_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS.description: Retries of a failed provider call. Default: 5.

FLEET_RUN_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Days run logs are kept. Default: 90.

FLEET_SANDBOX_BACKEND.description: Sandbox backend (ADR-0049). Validated fail-closed at boot against the bundle. The chart sets it from sandbox.backend; set that value instead. Default: podman.

FLEET_SANDBOX_CPUS.description: Per-sandbox CPU limit (e.g. 1.0). The chart sets it from sandbox.cpus; set that value instead.

FLEET_SANDBOX_CPUS_MAX.description: Ceiling a task may raise its sandbox CPUs to. Default: 16.

FLEET_SANDBOX_DISK_GB.description: Per-sandbox disk limit in GB; 0 uses the backend default. The chart sets it from sandbox.diskGB; set that value instead. Default: 0.

FLEET_SANDBOX_IMAGE.description: Sandbox image. Without one, lockdown is unavailable. The chart sets it from sandbox.image; set that value instead.

FLEET_SANDBOX_K8S_BUNDLE_DOCS_IN_IMAGE.description: Declares the sandbox image carries the bundle's doc dirs at the control plane's paths. The chart sets it from sandbox.kubernetes.bundleDocsInImage; set that value instead.

FLEET_SANDBOX_K8S_IMAGE_PULL_SECRET.description: Pull secret for the sandbox image. The chart sets it from sandbox.kubernetes.imagePullSecret; set that value instead.

FLEET_SANDBOX_K8S_KUBECONFIG.description: Kubeconfig for a control plane running outside the cluster. Default: in-cluster credentials.

FLEET_SANDBOX_K8S_NAMESPACE.description: Namespace of sandbox pods. The chart sets it from sandbox.kubernetes.namespace; set that value instead. Default: the kubeconfig context's namespace, else the control plane's own, else fleet-sandboxes.

FLEET_SANDBOX_K8S_NETWORK_POLICY.description: Name of the deny-all egress NetworkPolicy the boot preflight requires. The chart sets it from networkPolicies.denyAll.name; set that value instead. Default: fleet-sandbox-deny-all.

FLEET_SANDBOX_K8S_NODE_SELECTOR.description: Comma-separated key=value node selector for sandbox pods. The chart sets it from sandbox.kubernetes.nodeSelector; set that value instead.

FLEET_SANDBOX_K8S_OPEN_EGRESS_ACKNOWLEDG.description: Waive the open-egress policy requirement (logged as a warning on every start). The chart sets it from networkPolicies.openEgress.acknowledgeUnrestricted; set that value instead. Default: false.

FLEET_SANDBOX_K8S_OPEN_EGRESS_POLICY.description: Name of the NetworkPolicy shaping open-mode sandbox egress. The chart sets it from networkPolicies.openEgress.name; set that value instead. Default: fleet-sandbox-open-egress.

FLEET_SANDBOX_K8S_RUNTIME_CLASS.description: RuntimeClass of sandbox pods (e.g. kata); preflighted fail-closed. The chart sets it from sandbox.kubernetes.runtimeClass; set that value instead.

FLEET_SANDBOX_K8S_SECCOMP_PROFILE.description: Node-local Localhost seccomp profile for sandbox pods. The chart sets it from sandbox.kubernetes.seccompProfile; set that value instead. Default: RuntimeDefault.

FLEET_SANDBOX_K8S_SERVICE_ACCOUNT.description: ServiceAccount stamped on sandbox pods (no token is mounted). The chart sets it from sandbox.kubernetes.podServiceAccount; set that value instead.

FLEET_SANDBOX_K8S_TOLERATIONS.description: Tolerations for sandbox pods, as a JSON array. The chart sets it from sandbox.kubernetes.tolerations; set that value instead.

FLEET_SANDBOX_K8S_WORKSPACE_CLAIM.description: Shared workspace PersistentVolumeClaim every sandbox pod mounts. The chart sets it from workspace.claimName; set that value instead.

FLEET_SANDBOX_KATA_OVERHEAD_MB.description: Guest-memory overhead added for Kata sandboxes, in MiB. Default: 512.

FLEET_SANDBOX_MEMORY.description: Per-sandbox memory limit (podman format, e.g. 512m). The chart sets it from sandbox.memory; set that value instead.

FLEET_SANDBOX_MEMORY_MAX_MB.description: Ceiling a task may raise its sandbox memory to. Default: 8192.

FLEET_SANDBOX_PIDS.description: Per-sandbox process limit; 0 uses the backend default. Default: 0.

FLEET_SANDBOX_PIDS_MAX.description: Ceiling a task may raise its sandbox process limit to. Default: 1024.

FLEET_SANDBOX_RUNTIME.description: OCI runtime for podman sandboxes (e.g. a Kata or libkrun runtime, ADR-0010); fail-closed when unavailable.

FLEET_SANDBOX_SECCOMP_PROFILE.description: Podman seccomp override: a profile path, or `none`/`unconfined` (logged loudly). Refused by the kubernetes backend. Default: the embedded profile.

FLEET_SANDBOX_START_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Sandbox start timeout. Default: the backend's default.

FLEET_SANDBOX_STATS_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: Poll cadence of sandbox resource stats (floor 5 s). Default: 10.

FLEET_SANDBOX_WARM_SIZE.description: Warm-pool depth; 0 disables the warm pool. The chart sets it from sandbox.warmSize; set that value instead. Default: inherited from FLEET_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS.

FLEET_SANDBOX_WARM_TTL.description: Seconds an unused warm sandbox lives. Default: 300.

FLEET_SCHEDULED_AUTO_COMPACT.description: Let scheduled runs compact their context automatically. Default: false.

FLEET_SCHEDULED_SHARED_WORKSPACE.description: Kill switch for per-job workspaces: scheduled runs share the workspace root (ADR-0097). Default: false.

FLEET_SCHED_DATABASE_URL.description: Deprecated (ADR-0098): the scheduler store's own database on a box not yet consolidated; set, it selects the legacy two-database layout. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env. The chart sets it from postgres.enabled (in-cluster database secret; set that value instead.

FLEET_SCHED_DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT.description: Scheduler pool: timeout of the initial ping at startup. Default: 10s.

FLEET_SCHED_DB_MAX_CONNS.description: Scheduler pool: maximum open connections. Default: 25.

FLEET_SCHED_DB_MAX_CONN_IDLE_TIME.description: Scheduler pool: close a connection idle this long; 0 never does. Default: 0.

FLEET_SCHED_DB_MAX_CONN_LIFETIME.description: Scheduler pool: maximum connection lifetime; 0 is unlimited. Default: 5m.

FLEET_SCHED_DB_MIN_CONNS.description: Scheduler pool: maximum idle connections kept. Default: 5.

FLEET_SCHED_RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL_PER_MINUTE.description: Global task create/upload limit per minute; 0 disables. Default: 200.

FLEET_SCHED_RATE_LIMIT_PER_DAY.description: Per-principal task create/upload limit per day; 0 disables. Default: 500.

FLEET_SCHED_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Per-principal task create/upload limit per minute; 0 disables. Default: 60.

FLEET_SCHED_TICK_SECONDS.description: Interval of the due-task scan. Default: 30.

FLEET_SENTRY_DSN.description: Sentry-protocol ingest URL; unset makes Sentry a no-op. A public identifier, not a secret.

FLEET_SERVER_ADDR.description: Listen address of the chat API (and the webhooks it serves). Bound at startup; a change needs a restart. The chart sets it from fixed: 0.0.0.0:8080; set that value instead. Default: 127.0.0.1:8080.

FLEET_SERVER_TOKEN.description: Shared bearer token between the browser gateway and the chat/orchestrator APIs. Not reloadable. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

FLEET_SERVICE_NAME.description: systemd unit name the CLI manages, and the trace service name. Default: fleet.

FLEET_SHARED_FILES_MAX_TOTAL_MB.description: Total size cap on shared files, in MB. Also an admin setting. Default: 10240.

FLEET_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_SECONDS.description: How long a graceful shutdown waits for running turns and tasks before cancelling them; 0 cancels immediately. Default: 30.

FLEET_SMTP_PASSWORD.description: SMTP password. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

FLEET_SSE_BUFFER_DURATION.description: How long a finished turn's SSE events stay in memory for reattach. Default: 60m.

FLEET_SSE_BUFFER_MAX_BYTES_PER_TURN.description: Cap on the in-memory SSE replay buffer per turn, in bytes. Default: 5242880.

FLEET_SSE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL.description: Idle keepalive cadence on an attached SSE stream; 0 disables. Default: 15s.

FLEET_SUBAGENTS_BUDGET_FRACTION.description: Each child's share of the parent's remaining budget; out-of-range values are clamped. Default: 0.10.

FLEET_SUBAGENTS_ENABLED.description: Sub-agent delegation; false is the fleet-wide kill switch. Also an admin setting. Default: true.

FLEET_SUBAGENTS_MAX_CHILDREN.description: Maximum children one parent may spawn. Default: 20.

FLEET_SUBAGENTS_MAX_DEPTH.description: Maximum delegation depth (1 = the root may delegate, children may not). Default: 1.

FLEET_SUBAGENTS_MODEL.description: Model sub-agents run on. Default: the parent's model.

FLEET_TASK_DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES.description: max_retries of a task created without one. Default: 1.

FLEET_TASK_FALLBACK_MODEL.description: Model the scheduler falls back to when a task's own model is unavailable.

FLEET_TASK_MEMORY_MAX_KEYS.description: Maximum persistent memory keys per task. Default: 100.

FLEET_TASK_MEMORY_MAX_VALUE_BYTES.description: Maximum size of one task memory value. Default: 4096.

FLEET_TASK_STARVATION_WINDOW_MINUTES.description: Anti-starvation window of the priority queue; 0 disables. Default: 30.

FLEET_TASK_WALL_TIMEOUT.description: Wall-clock limit of one scheduled run; 0 disables. Default: 4h.

FLEET_TEAM_CHATS_SHARED_BY_DEFAULT.description: New chats are shared with the creator's team by default. Also an admin setting. Default: false.

FLEET_TEMPERATURE.description: Sampling temperature for chat and scheduled runs. Hot-reloadable. Default: 0.3.

FLEET_TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone of the server clock used by the scheduler. Default: UTC.

FLEET_TITLE_MODEL.description: Model that titles conversations. Default: anthropic/claude-opus-5.5.

FLEET_TLS_ACME_EMAIL.description: Contact email registered with the ACME CA.

FLEET_TLS_DOMAIN.description: Domain the ACME certificate is issued for (FLEET_TLS_MODE=auto).

FLEET_TLS_HTTP_ADDR.description: The HTTP→HTTPS redirect and ACME HTTP-01 challenge listener, when fleet terminates TLS itself. Default: :80.

FLEET_TLS_MODE.description: TLS termination by the chat listener itself. Most deployments leave it off and terminate TLS in Caddy. Default: off.

FLEET_TOOL_DISCLOSURE_THRESHOLD.description: Tool count above which tools are disclosed on demand rather than all up front. Default: the provider's tool ceiling.

FLEET_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated reverse-proxy IPs whose X-Forwarded-For fleet trusts. Empty (the default) never reads X-Forwarded-For.

FLEET_TURN_EVENT_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Days a finished turn keeps its durable SSE ledger; 0 disables the sweep. Default: 14.

FLEET_TURN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Wall-clock limit of one chat turn. Default: 14400.

FLEET_UPDATE_DRAIN_FILE.description: Path of the update drain sentinel; a relative path resolves under /etc/fleet. While it exists the server reports not-ready and starts no new work. Default: inherited from FLEET_DRAIN_FILE.

FLEET_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES.description: Per-file cap on chat attachment uploads, in bytes. Default: 1073741824.

FLEET_VAPID_CONTACT.description: Web Push VAPID contact (mailto: or https: URL).

FLEET_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Web Push VAPID private key. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

FLEET_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Web Push VAPID public key (`fleet generate-vapid-keys`). Push is off unless all three VAPID keys are set.

FLEET_VERIFIER_MODEL.description: Dedicated model for the scheduled end-of-run completeness verifier. The verifier runs when a fallback model (the task's or FLEET_TASK_FALLBACK_MODEL) or this variable is set; the fallback model only retries a verifier call that produced no verdict. A slug that does not resolve is logged and the run's own model verifies. Default: the run's own model.

FLEET_WEBHOOK_BODY_TEMPLATE.description: Body template of the outbound webhook. Treated as a secret: a template can embed a token. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

FLEET_WEBHOOK_METHOD.description: HTTP method of the outbound webhook. Default: POST.

FLEET_WEBHOOK_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Per-slug rate limit on inbound webhook triggers. Default: 10.

FLEET_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret of the outbound webhook; unset sends it unsigned. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

FLEET_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Outbound webhook for task notifications. Treated as a secret: Slack-style webhook URLs carry their token in the path. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

FLEET_WEB_ADDR.description: Listen address of the browser tier (the embedded web UI and every browser /api route, ADR-0091). `off`, `none`, `disabled` or `0` runs API-only with no browser tier. The chart sets it from fixed: 0.0.0.0:3000; set that value instead. Default: 127.0.0.1:3000.

FLEET_WEB_DEV_SERVER.description: Development only (`make dev`): proxy the SPA to this Vite dev server instead of serving the embedded bundle.

FLEET_WORKSPACE_DOWNLOAD_MAX_BYTES.description: Cap on a task-workspace download, in bytes. Default: 52428800.

FLEET_WORKSPACE_ROOT.description: Workspace root the sandbox mounts and the file tools are confined to. The chart sets it from workspaceRoot; set that value instead. Default: ./workspace.

FLEET_WORKTREE_PRUNE_AGE.description: Age after which idle git worktrees are pruned; 0 disables the sweep. Default: 24h.

GH_TOKEN.description: GitHub token admitted from the env file for MCP servers that use the gh CLI; fleet itself does not read it. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

LLM_MAX_TOKENS.description: Maximum output tokens per model call. Default: 16384.

LOG_LEVEL.description: A cutlass-era knob: fleet reads nothing from it, but it stays admitted from the env file and reserved from connectors. Use FLEET_LOG_LEVEL.

MAX_ITERATIONS.description: A cutlass-era knob: fleet reads nothing from it, but it stays admitted from the env file and reserved from connectors for MCP servers and scripts that predate fleet. Use FLEET_MAX_ITERATIONS.

NEXT_PUBLIC_PUBLIC_ORIGIN.description: Fallback for FLEET_PUBLIC_BASE_URL on a box whose env file predates the move off the Next.js tier (ADR-0091).

OPENAI_CUSTOM_HEADERS.description: The OpenAI SDK's own header-injection variable. Fleet strips every header it names from requests to OpenAI-compatible providers, so a host-level setting cannot leak into them. Treated as a secret: a header line can carry an Authorization value or an API key. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: OpenRouter API key. Set it with `fleet config set-openrouter-key`. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

OPENROUTER_BASE_URL.description: Override of the OpenRouter API base URL (tests point it at the fake LLM).

OPENROUTER_HTTP_REFERER.description: HTTP-Referer header sent with image-generation calls (OpenRouter app attribution).

OPENROUTER_X_TITLE.description: X-Title header sent with image-generation calls (OpenRouter app attribution).

ORCHESTRATOR_SERVER_TOKEN.description: Bearer token the browser gateway presents to the orchestrator; defaults to FLEET_SERVER_TOKEN. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env. Default: inherited from FLEET_SERVER_TOKEN.

SCHED_DATABASE_URL.description: Deprecated (ADR-0098): bare legacy spelling of the scheduler store's DSN in the legacy two-database layout. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

SENDGRID_API_KEY.description: SendGrid key for outbound email. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

SYSTEM_PROMPT.description: System-prompt file name in the bundle; .md is appended when no known extension is given. Default: default.md.

TAVILY_API_KEY.description: Tavily key for the web-search tool. Secret: set it through config.existingSecret, not config.env.

VERBOSE.description: A cutlass-era knob: fleet reads nothing from it, but it stays admitted from the env file and reserved from connectors.

web.description: REMOVED (ADR-0091): the fleet image serves the web UI itself. Accepted only so templates/web.yaml can fail an old values file with the upgrade steps.
